major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it off the global cooldown first in every burst window so Execution Sentence, Wake of Ashes and Divine Toll all land inside it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 31884 is the cast and the self aura seen in 5/5 parses; 454351 is an unobserved twin aura. talent_gated is set because Radiant Glory removes the button and applies the buff from Wake of Ashes instead.

major_cooldowns.name: Execution Sentence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pack as much damage as you can into its window and keep cleaving every target it hit, since all of that damage feeds its hammer.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 343527 is the cast id; 1234189 is the self aura and 1260251 the enemy debuff.

major_cooldowns.name: Wake of Ashes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Follow every cast with Hammer of Light straight away, and with Radiant Glory send it inside your Execution Sentence window so the free Avenging Wrath lands there.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 255937 is the cast id; 255941 is the enemy debuff, 405345 and 405350 are unobserved twins.

major_cooldowns.name: Hammer of Light
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it right after every Wake of Ashes, and hold a free Light's Deliverance proc only when Avenging Wrath is about to come back or Undisputed Ruling is still running.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Templar-only button; the guide names 427453, twin 429826 is also unobserved, and none of the 5 sampled parses ran the build. It has no cooldown of its own and base_cd_s is blank, so the 30s here is the Wake of Ashes gate the guide describes.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it last in each cooldown window so the Divine Resonance Hammer of Wraths it grants land inside Execution Sentence.

major_cooldowns.name: Voracious Heart of Ula'tek
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it with Avenging Wrath ahead of your other cooldowns, and keep sending it on cooldown rather than banking it a full cycle to resync.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use raid trinket cast in 2/5 sampled parses; talent_gated so players on other trinkets are not flagged for zero casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Line it up with Avenging Wrath ahead of your other cooldowns, and hold it a few seconds on pull so its stats sit inside the crit buff.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket cast in 2/5 sampled parses; talent_gated so players on other trinkets are not flagged for zero casts.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it to walk through a hit that would kill you or to clear a deadly debuff.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for the moment you or a tank are about to die, since it refills the target to full health.

defensives.name: Divine Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into every predictable damage spike, and with Shield of Vengeance talented it drops your absorb at the same time.
defensives.id_note: 403876 is the cast and the self aura; Shield of Vengeance (184662) appears only as an aura it applies, so it is not listed as its own button.

defensives.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Put it on the tank or a struggling ally during heavy damage, and only while your own health is high since you take the damage they avoid.

rules.description: Open Blade of Justice, Avenging Wrath, Wake of Ashes
rules.action: Lead with Blade of Justice, buff with Avenging Wrath and your on-use trinkets, then dump Wake of Ashes and Divine Toll.

rules.description: Spend Holy Power before Blade of Justice caps it
rules.action: Spend down with Final Verdict or Divine Storm first so the Holy Power it generates is not thrown away.

rules.description: Divine Storm replaces Final Verdict in AoE
rules.action: Swap your Holy Power spender to Divine Storm once the extra targets are up.

rules.description: Divine Storm spends your Divine Arbiter procs
rules.action: Send Divine Storm as your next full Holy Power spender while the Arbiter buff is up.

rules.description: Spend Art of War procs with Blade of Justice
rules.action: Fire Blade of Justice as soon as the reset procs instead of banking the second stack.

rules.description: Save Execution Sentence and Divine Toll for Avenging Wrath
rules.action: Fire them inside the Avenging Wrath window instead of seconds before it comes up.
